nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory ACP session manager that caches ACPSessionState (model, variant, mode) per session id, deduplicates concurrent server loads through a pendingLoads map, and syncs create/load/remove operations with the SDK.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately in-memory only — ACP protocol methods don't send cwd with every request, so the manager re-loads from the server on demand; get() throws RequestError.invalidParams while tryGet() silently drops unknown sessions.

nodes.name: ACPSessionManager
nodes.summary: Caches ACPSessionState per session with tryGet/getOrLoad/tryGetOrLoad accessors and setters for model, variant, and mode; concurrent loads of the same id share one in-flight promise via pendingLoads, and remove() evicts the cached entry.

nodes.name: tool-dispatch.ts
nodes.summary: Translates opencode tool-call parts into ACP tool_call updates: a pending/in-progress/completed/failed state machine with shell output dedup, edit/read location derivation, todo-plan decoding, and image content extraction.
nodes.languageNotes: handleToolPartUpdate centralizes all tool state transitions and deduplicates shell output by hashing so ACP clients don't receive repeated identical output blocks.

nodes.name: shellOutput
nodes.summary: Extracts the combined stdout/stderr output text from a running shell tool part.

nodes.name: toolStart
nodes.summary: Emits the initial pending tool_call update for a call id, deduplicated through the shared toolStarts set so each call is announced to the ACP client exactly once.

nodes.name: handleToolPartUpdate
nodes.summary: State machine for tool parts across running, pending, and completed-error states: emits in-progress updates (with shell output deduped by hash), completed updates carrying content blocks or decoded todo plans, and failed updates with error content and raw output.

nodes.name: toToolKind
nodes.summary: Maps opencode tool names (edit, write, bash, read, fetch, move, search...) to ACP ToolKind values, defaulting to other.

nodes.name: toLocations
nodes.summary: Derives ACP Locations (file path plus optional line range) from tool input metadata for edit, read, and move tools.

nodes.name: completedToolContent
nodes.summary: Builds the ACP content blocks for a completed tool call from its title, metadata, and image attachments.

nodes.name: completedToolRawOutput
nodes.summary: Serializes a completed tool part's state (output, metadata, error) into the rawOutput payload for ACP clients.

nodes.name: imageContents
nodes.summary: Converts image attachments carrying data URIs into ACP image content blocks, ignoring non-image mime types.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared ACP types: ACPSessionState (per-session id, cwd, MCP servers, model/variant/mode) and ACPConfig (SDK client plus optional default model) used by the agent adapter and session manager.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-system notes documenting subagent permission invariants: allow-only has() semantics for tool restrictions, deny-only forwarding with first-wins dedupe in deriveSubagentSessionPermission, prompt permission merging rules, and the shared V1/V2 helpers in subagent-permissions.ts.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Central agent registry as an Effect service: defines the built-in agents (build, plan, general, explore, scout, compaction, title, summary) with layered permission rulesets, merges user config overrides and scout reference agents per instance, and exposes get/list/defaultAgent plus an LLM-backed generate() that turns a description into a new agent config.
nodes.languageNotes: Agent state is built per-instance via InstanceState (config, skills, and scout references resolved lazily); Permission.merge composes defaults + per-agent + user rulesets; generate() uses the AI SDK's generateObject/streamObject with provider-specific system prompt delivery and avoids colliding identifiers.

nodes.name: generate.txt
nodes.summary: System prompt for the LLM-driven agent generator, instructing the model to turn a natural-language description into a JSON agent config (identifier, whenToUse with Task-tool examples, systemPrompt); imported by agent.ts as PROMPT_GENERATE.

nodes.name: subagent-permissions.ts
nodes.summary: Shared V1/V2 subagent permission helpers: derives the subagent session permission with deny-only parent forwarding and first-wins dedupe, and computes tool enable/disable restrictions from primary_tools.

nodes.name: dedupe
nodes.summary: Deduplicates permission rules by pattern+permission key, keeping the first occurrence encountered (earlier entries win).

nodes.name: deriveSubagentSessionPermission
nodes.summary: Merges the subagent's permission with deny rules forwarded from the parent agent, deduped first-wins; only deny rules propagate from the parent so subagents never gain extra rights.

nodes.name: subagentSessionPermission
nodes.summary: Wraps deriveSubagentSessionPermission and additionally grants an allow rule for each of the subagent's primary tools.

nodes.name: subagentToolRestrictions
nodes.summary: Builds a tools enable/disable record from primary_tools — a tool is enabled only when the subagent's permission rules contain an explicit allow for it.

nodes.name: audio.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declarations enabling default imports of .wav and .wasm asset files as URL strings for the bundler.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Auth credential store as an Effect service: reads and writes auth.json (mode 0600) with OAuth, API-key, and well-known variants discriminated by type, honoring OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT for injected credentials and normalizing trailing-slash provider keys.
nodes.languageNotes: A Schema.Class union with a type discriminator gives typed decoding of the stored file; the OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT env var overrides the file entirely; writes strip duplicate trailing-slash keys.

nodes.name: bus-event.ts
nodes.summary: Typed bus event definition factory: registers event types with their Effect Schema properties and regenerates the effectPayloads schema set (id/type/properties) used for the SDK event union.

nodes.name: define
nodes.summary: Registers a bus event type with its properties schema in the module registry and returns a definition object carrying the type string and schema.

nodes.name: effectPayloads
nodes.summary: Maps every registered event definition to an Effect Schema struct (id, literal type, properties) annotated as Event.<type> for the generated SDK event union.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Process-wide GlobalBus EventEmitter that stamps emitted event payloads with an ascending evt id (reusing the sync event's id when present), fanning bus events out to non-Effect listeners.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The core event bus as an Effect service: per-instance typed and wildcard PubSubs created via InstanceState, publish/subscribe/subscribeAll streams, callback subscriptions bridged into fibers via EffectBridge, GlobalBus fan-out, and an InstanceDisposed event published on shutdown; module-level publish/subscribe wrappers run the service outside Effect contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Each event type gets its own unbounded PubSub alongside a wildcard PubSub; a scope finalizer publishes server.instance.disposed before shutdown; EffectBridge plus an explicit Scope converts Effect streams into plain callback subscriptions with proper cleanup.
